# Images in live preview

A local image appears below its line, in the measure:

![An arch, drawn in green](figures/arch.png)

An image from the web is never loaded; its address shows instead:

![A remote photograph](https://example.com/photo.jpg)

An image outside the library is refused: ![Outside](../outside.png)

So is a file that is missing: ![Missing](figures/none.png)
